verdict.rationale: A community user reports running the "Fedora 39 KDE Spin" without problems, and another mentions Silverblue. Together these show Fedora variants beyond the default GNOME Workstation, but the first-party evidence covers only the Workstation edition and never documents a set of official variants. missing for 10: first-party documentation of official spins/editions and their desktop environments, evidence of a choice among multiple DEs beyond KDE, and evidence that default app selections differ by variant.
